_comment: In-app products. The ids must match fab-shop/js/store.js exactly; tools/check-store-metadata.js checks that, and the length limits below. Prices are suggestions - set them in each console.

products.play_type: One-time product (the app never consumes it)
products.name: Union Contract
products.apple_description: Every job pays double, for good.
products.play_description: Every job pays double - in this shop and every shop after it. A one-time purchase that survives resets and selling up.

products.play_type: One-time product (the app never consumes it)
products.name: Night Crew
products.apple_description: Operators work twice as hard offline.
products.play_description: While you are away, your operators work twice as fast and keep going for 12 days instead of 6. A one-time purchase.

products.play_type: One-time product (the app consumes it, so it can be bought again)
products.name: Big Contract
products.apple_description: A one-off cash boost for your shop.
products.play_description: A one-off contract paid straight into the bank, worth three of your best days. Can be bought again.
